files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body:
Initial Notes CalDAV implementation.

- Added CalDAV provider for Nextcloud Notes
- Nextcloud Notes remains the canonical data store
- Each Note is exposed as a VJOURNAL
- Notes VJOURNAL resources intentionally have no DTSTART
- Added deterministic canonical resource names using the Notes ID:
  `note-<id>.ics`
- Added deterministic VJOURNAL UIDs:
  `nextcloud-notes-<id>@nextcloud`
- Added SUMMARY mapping for Note titles
- Added DESCRIPTION mapping for Note Markdown content
- Added CATEGORIES mapping for Notes categories
- Added X-NEXTCLOUD-FAVORITE mapping for favorites
- Added LAST-MODIFIED and DTSTAMP
- Added content-dependent ETags
- Added CalDAV CREATE support
- Added CalDAV UPDATE support
- Added CalDAV DELETE support
- Temporary client-generated resource names are accepted for CREATE
- Newly created Notes are subsequently exposed using their canonical
  `note-<id>.ics` resource
- No separate DAV-to-Notes ID mapping table is required
- Added handling for unreadable Notes: entries causing
  `OCP\Files\GenericFileException` are skipped without breaking the complete
  CalDAV collection
- Tested synchronization with DAVx5
- Tested creating Notes from JTX Board
- Tested editing Notes from JTX Board
- Tested deleting Notes from JTX Board
- Verified CalDAV changes through the Nextcloud Notes REST API
- Tested with Nextcloud 34
